title: Road Signs and Signals V1.1
description: Road signs, signals, and markings per the Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals.

Header.description: Road Signs and Signals Header – Standard CAV-RSS-Vx.y

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Road Signs and Signals instance.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Road Signs and Signals instance.

RSSID.description: Unique identifier of this Road Signs and Signals instance.

RSSTime.description: Time this Road Signs and Signals instance was produced.

RSSSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Road Signs and Signals instance applies.

DangerWarningSigns.description: Signs warning road users of existing or potential dangers ahead.

IndicateDanger.description: Indicates the presence of a Danger Warning Sign.

PrioritySigns.description: Signs indicating priority rules at intersections or road sections.

IndicatePriority.description: Indicates the presence of a Priority Sign.

ProhibitorySigns.description: Signs indicating prohibitions or restrictions applicable to road users.

IndicateProhibition.description: Indicates the presence of a Prohibitory Sign.

MandatorySigns.description: Signs indicating mandatory obligations for road users.

IndicateObligation.description: Indicates the presence of a Mandatory Sign.

SpecialRegulationSigns.description: Signs indicating special traffic regulations applicable in specific areas or lanes.

IndicateSpecialRegulation.description: Indicates the presence of a Special Regulation Sign.

InformatorySigns.description: Signs providing information, services, or guidance to road users.

ProvideInformation.description: Indicates the presence of an Informatory Sign.

TrafficLightSignals.description: Light signals regulating traffic movement by colour, position, or flashing mode.

SignalTrafficMovement.description: Indicates the presence of a Traffic Light Signal.

RoadMarkings.description: Markings applied on the road surface to convey regulations, warnings, or guidance.

ConveyRoadInformation.description: Indicates the presence of Road Markings.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Road Signs and Signals instance in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Road Signs and Signals instance (plain text, max 2048 characters).
